item.title: Chung Jin-suk: "If It Harms Party Unity, I Will Withdraw My Candidacy" (정진석 “당 결속 해친다면 출마 접겠다”)
item.description:
Chung Jin-suk: "If It Harms Party Unity, I Will Withdraw My Candidacy" (정진석 “당 결속 해친다면 출마 접겠다”)

Former National Assembly Deputy Speaker Chung Jin-suk withdrew his candidacy for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province on the 7th, stating, "I will return to being an unnamed ordinary party member and serve as a common soldier." (정진석 전 국회 부의장이 7일 “이름 없는 평당원으로 돌아가 백의종군하겠다”며 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 후보 신청을 철회했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Chung said, "It is painful for me, but it will also be very painful for the party," adding, "If my candidacy harms party unity or weakens our party's momentum to stop the monopoly of immense power, I will halt that path." (정 전 부의장은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “저도 고통이지만 당도 많이 고통스러울 것”이라며 “저의 출마가 당의 결속을 해치거나 거대 권력의 독주를 막아낼 우리 당의 동력을 약화시킨다면 그 길을 멈추겠다”고 했다.)

After Chung, a former chief of staff to President Yoon Suk Yeol, applied for nomination in this by-election, criticism of a 'pro-Yoon nomination' emerged both within and outside the party. Kim Tae-heum, the South Chungcheong Province governor candidate, opposed Chung's nomination and indefinitely postponed his preliminary candidate registration. Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae also launched attacks, asking, "Is this a 'Yoon Again' nomination?" and "Yoon Suk Yeol, even from prison, should give nominations." (윤석열 전 대통령 비서실장을 지낸 정 전 부의장이 이번 보궐선거에 공천을 신청한 뒤 당 안팎에서는 ‘친윤 공천’이라는 비판이 나왔다. 김태흠 충남지사 후보는 정 전 부의장 공천에 반대하며 예비 후보 등록을 무기한 연기했다. 정청래 더불어민주당 대표도 “‘윤 어게인’ 공천이냐” “윤석열도 옥중 공천하라”고 공세를 쏟아냈다.)

It is known that Park Deok-heum, chairman of the People Power Party's nomination management committee and a relative by marriage, persuaded Chung to decide to withdraw his candidacy that day. Chairman Park told reporters, "I met with former Deputy Speaker Chung over lunch, explained the party's difficult position in detail, and did a lot of persuading." (이날 정 전 부의장의 출마 포기 결정에는 사돈 지간인 박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장의 설득이 있었던 것으로 알려졌다. 박 위원장은 이날 기자들과 만나 “점심에 정 전 부의장을 만나 당이 어려운 입장을 자세히 설명하고 설득을 많이 했다”고 했다.)

The nomination committee plans to finalize the nomination for this region soon. This area, with strong conservative tendencies, was previously the district of Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun for the South Chungcheong governor race, and the Democratic Party has yet to complete its candidate nomination. (공관위는 조만간 이 지역 공천을 마무리할 방침이다. 보수세가 강한 이 지역은 민주당 박수현 충남지사 후보의 직전 지역구인데, 민주당도 아직 후보 공천을 마무리하지 못한 상태다.)

item.title: Lee: "Hoarding leads to ruin... Even if we want to go easy, we can't" (李 “매점매석은 망하는 길... 봐주고 싶어도 못 봐줘”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th, "If you try to make a quick buck by hoarding goods, you will end up completely ruined," adding, "Once caught, even if we want to show leniency, we cannot." (이재명 대통령은 8일 “돈 좀 벌어보겠다고 매점매석하다가는 완전히 망하게 된다”며 “발각되면 봐주고 싶어도 봐줄 수가 없다”고 했다.)

President Lee made these remarks on X (formerly Twitter), saying, "There are still those who don't realize the world has changed and are heading down a path of ruin with outdated thinking, so I am informing you in advance." As concerns grow over supply instability for medical products like syringes due to the prolonged Middle East conflict, the government has decided to strengthen sanctions, including introducing new fines for hoarding. (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 “아직도 세상이 변한 걸 모르고 구시대적 사고로 망하는 길을 가는 분들이 있어 미리 알려 드린다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 중동 전쟁 장기화로 인한 주사기와 같은 의료제품 등에 대한 수급 불안이 커지자, 정부는 매점매석 행위에 대한 과징금을 신설하는 등 제재 수위를 높이기로 했다.)

President Lee noted, "Under the law, those who engage in hoarding will have all hoarded items confiscated, and if confiscation is difficult, their value will be recovered as surcharges. Since this is a mandatory confiscation, meaning confiscation and surcharges are obligatory, once discovered, there is no room for leniency." (이 대통령은 “법률상 매점매석을 하면 매점매석 대상인 물품 전체를 몰수하고, 몰수가 어려우면 그 가액을 추징한다”며 “필요적 몰수, 즉 몰수 추징이 의무이기 때문에 일단 발각되면 봐주고 싶어도 봐줄 수가 없다”고 했다.)

He followed up by asking, "What if you don't get caught?" and added, "With a reward-based reporting system that pays 20-30% of the value of hoarded goods as a reward, is it possible to avoid being caught?" He concluded, "The era of abnormality is ending, and the era of normalcy has begun. If you try to gain unfair profits by relying on abnormality, you'll pay a heavy price." (이어 “들키지 않으면 된다구요?”라며 “신고 포상제로 매점매석 물건 가액의 20~30%를 포상금으로 지급하는데 안들킬 수 있을까요?”라고 했다. 이어 “이제 비정상의 시대는 저물고 정상시대가 시작되었다”며 “비정상에 기대 부당이익을 취하려다가는 큰코 다친다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Announces First Filibuster on Constitutional Amendment Bill in National Assembly History (국힘, 헌정사 첫 개헌안 본회의 필버 예고)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) decided on the 8th to respond with a filibuster (a lawful obstruction of legislative proceedings through unlimited debate) against 50 bills, including the constitutional amendment bill, scheduled to be re-tabled at a plenary session of the National Assembly without agreement between the ruling and opposition parties. However, as the PPP also plans not to participate in the vote on this day, the constitutional amendment bill is expected to be declared "vote invalid" like the previous day. <<> On this day, PPP Floor Leader Song Eon-seok stated in an internal notice, "Our party will respond with unlimited debate to all agenda items tabled at the plenary session being held unilaterally without consensus." <<> During a floor strategy meeting, Floor Leader Song Eon-seok said, "National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's remarks about holding today's plenary session amount to unilaterally pushing ahead with a schedule not agreed upon by the ruling and opposition negotiating groups," and described it as "a unconstitutional statement and act that ignores the Constitution." National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party of Korea had announced they would reattempt a vote on the constitutional amendment bill, which had failed the previous day due to the PPP's absence. <<> It is reported that if the PPP filibusters the constitutional amendment bill at the plenary session scheduled for 2 PM today, it would be the first filibuster of a constitutional amendment bill in the history of Korea's constitutional government. The constitutional amendment bill promoted by the Democratic Party of Korea and others includes provisions to enshrine the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble of the Constitution, and to strengthen requirements for martial law, such as requiring immediate approval from the National Assembly when the president declares martial law. From the early stages of the constitutional amendment push, the PPP has argued that "while we do not oppose the content, we should not rush through a constitutional amendment ahead of local elections." <<> However, the PPP is also expected not to participate in the vote today. The previous day, the National Assembly tabled the constitutional amendment bill at a plenary session, but due to failing to meet the quorum of 191 votes (two-thirds of the total registered lawmakers), the vote was declared invalid. <<> Meanwhile, the PPP has stated that in addition to the constitutional amendment bill, it will also filibuster 50 non-contentious bills tabled at today's plenary session. (국민의힘이 8일 국회 본회의에 여야 합의 없이 다시 상정될 예정인 헌법 개정안과 법안 50건에 대해 필리버스터(무제한 토론을 통한 합법적 의사 진행 방해)로 대응하기로 했다. 다만 국민의힘은 이날도 표결에는 참여하지 않을 계획이라 개헌안은 전날에 이어 ‘투표 불성립’이 될 전망이다.)

item.title: Chung Won-oh: "Oh, all talk on housing supply" Oh Se-hoon: "If Chung wins, it's real estate hell" (정원오 “吳, 말로만 주택 공급” 오세훈 “鄭 되면 부동산 지옥”)
item.description:
Chung Won-oh: "Oh, all talk on housing supply" Oh Se-hoon: "If Chung wins, it's real estate hell" (정원오 “吳, 말로만 주택 공급” 오세훈 “鄭 되면 부동산 지옥”)

Democratic Party of Korea Seoul mayoral candidate Chung Won-oh and People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon have been locked in an escalating battle over real estate issues in recent days. Both candidates have put forward pledges to accelerate reconstruction and redevelopment, while accusing each other of copying their proposals or offering ineffective solutions to the city's housing problems. (더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보와 국민의힘 서울시장 오세훈 후보가 연일 부동산 문제를 두고 공방을 벌이고 있다. 두 후보 모두 재건축·재개발 속도를 높이겠다는 공약을 내놓은 가운데, 서로 상대방 공약이 자기 공약을 베낀 것이라거나 부동산 문제 해결에 소용없는 것이라고 비난했다.)

On the afternoon of the 7th, Candidate Chung visited the Geoyeo Saemaeul District in Songpa-gu, the only public redevelopment site in Seoul's affluent Gangnam three districts. "Here, integrated reviews were resolved in three months, and project reviews in just two months," Chung said. "Ultimately, how quickly redevelopment moves depends on close administrative engagement, and that's exactly what my 'Step-by-Step Development' aims to achieve." Targeting Oh, he added, "Four years ago, he promised to supply 80,000 housing units annually, but he didn't even manage half that—40,000." In a statement released that day, Chung's camp said, "Candidate Oh has only paid lip service to housing supply while turning a blind eye to the housing stability of ordinary citizens and the collapse of local communities. He is incompetent." Chung's key pledge, "Step-by-Step Development," is centered on reducing the redevelopment timeline by three years. Chung also vowed to transfer authority for designating redevelopment zones with fewer than 500 households from the Seoul city government to district offices and to revitalize public redevelopment. (정 후보는 7일 오후 서울 강남 3구의 유일한 공공 재개발 현장인 송파구 거여새마을지구를 찾았다. 정 후보는 “이곳은 통합 심의가 3개월, 사업 심의가 2개월 만에 해결됐다”며 “결국 정비 사업이 얼마나 빠르게 진행되는지는 행정의 밀착에 달려 있는데, 이것이 바로 정원오의 ‘착착 개발’”이라고 했다. 오 후보를 겨냥해서는 “4년 전 매년 8만호씩 주택을 공급하겠다고 했는데 그 절반인 4만호도 안 했다”고 했다. 정 후보 측은 이날 대변인 논평에서 “오 후보는 말로만 주택 공급을 외치면서 정작 서민들의 주거 안정과 지역 공동체 붕괴에는 눈을 감아 왔다”며 “오 후보는 무능하다”고 했다. ‘착착 개발’은 정 후보의 핵심 공약으로 재개발을 소요 기간을 3년 단축하겠다는 것이 골자다. 정 후보는 또 500세대 미만 재개발 구역 지정 권한을 서울시에서 자치구로 넘기고, 공공 재개발도 활성화하겠다고 했다.)

Candidate Oh, meanwhile, visited areas like Daerim-dong in Yeongdeungpo-gu and Guui-dong in Gwangjin-gu on the same day, promoting his "Supply No Matter What" approach. "Seoul doesn't have much vacant land, so the key to supply lies in 'overwhelming speed,'" Oh said. He pledged to break ground on a total of 310,000 housing units by 2031 to secure an overwhelming supply volume. (오 후보는 이날 영등포구 대림동과 광진구 구의동 등을 연달아 찾아 “‘닥공’, 즉 닥치고 공급”이라며 “서울에는 유휴 부지가 많지 않기 때문에, 공급의 완성은 ‘압도적 속도’에서 나온다”고 했다. 오 후보는 “2031년까지 총 31만호의 주택 착공을 이뤄내, 압도적인 주택 공급 물량을 확보하겠다”고 약속했다.)

To accelerate supply, Oh said he would designate 85,000 units across 85 redevelopment zones as "core strategic maintenance zones" for intensive management. He also promised to introduce a "fast-track integration" system, allowing redevelopment processes to skip the step of forming a promotion committee and enabling the Seoul city government to issue both project implementation approval and management disposal plan approval simultaneously. (오 후보는 공급 속도를 높이기 위해 85개 재개발 구역의 8만5000호를 ‘핵심 전략 정비 구역’으로 선정해 집중 관리하겠다고 했다. 또 ‘쾌속 통합’ 트랙을 도입해, 재개발 절차에서 추진위원회 구성 단계를 생략할 수 있도록 하고, 서울시가 사업 시행 인가와 관리 처분 계획 인가를 한 번에 내주도록 하겠다고 약속했다.)

Targeting Chung, Oh said on a radio program that day, "Reconstruction and redevelopment take 10 to 20 years, so Chung is quietly shifting his focus to townhouses. If Chung gets elected, 'real estate hell' will become a reality." Chung's camp countered that Oh's "fast-track integration" was a copy of Chung's "Step-by-Step Development" pledge. (오 후보는 정 후보를 겨냥해서는 이날 라디오에서 “재개발·재건축은 10~20년이 걸리니, 정 후보가 슬쩍 빌라 쪽에 무게중심을 두고 있다”며 “정 후보가 당선되면 ‘부동산 지옥’이 현실화된다”고 했다. 정 후보 측은 오 후보의 ‘쾌속 통합’이 정 후보의 ‘착착 개발’을 베낀 것이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Devoted parents must enjoy their old age without worry... We will expand support such as integrated care." (李대통령 “헌신한 부모들, 걱정 없이 노후 누려야…통합돌봄 등 지원 확대하겠다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Devoted parents must enjoy their old age without worry... We will expand support such as integrated care." (李대통령 “헌신한 부모들, 걱정 없이 노후 누려야…통합돌봄 등 지원 확대하겠다”)

On Parents' Day, the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung stated, "We will move toward a 'nation where the people are happy,' where the state and community share responsibility, rather than a society that relies on the unilateral sacrifice of parents." He also said, "The government of the people's sovereignty is preparing institutional measures to guarantee a healthy and vibrant old age, including integrated community care, dementia-safe property management services, 1.15 million senior jobs, and improvement of the unfair pension system." (이재명 대통령은 어버이날인 8일 “부모의 일방적 희생에 기대는 사회가 아니라, 국가와 공동체가 함께 책임지는 ‘국민이 행복한 나라’로 나아갈 것”이라고 밝혔다. “국민주권 정부는 지역사회 통합 돌봄, 치매 안심 재산 관리 서비스, 115만개의 노인 일자리, 불합리한 연금 제도 개선 등 건강하고 활기찬 노후를 보장할 제도적 방안을 마련하고 있다”고도 했다.)

On this day, President Lee posted on Facebook an article titled "To the Parents Who Willingly Embraced the World Called Their Children," in which he expressed, "I extend my deepest respect and gratitude to all parents in this land," adding these remarks. President Lee said, "A single parent lives bearing as many worlds as the number of their children. I only truly realized this after becoming a father of two," and added, "Today's Republic of Korea stands on the silent devotion of parents who unselfishly offered their backs, lifted their children up whenever they fell, and set aside their own today for the sake of their children's tomorrow." (이 대통령은 이날 페이스북에 ‘자식이라는 세계를 기꺼이 품어온 부모님들께’라는 제목의 글을 올려 “이 땅의 모든 부모님께 깊은 존경과 감사의 인사를 드린다”며 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 “한 사람의 부모는 자식 숫자만큼의 세상을 짊어지고 살아간다. 두 아이의 아버지가 되고서야 비로소 실감을 한다”며 “아무 조건 없이 등을 내어주고, 넘어질 때마다 다시 일으켜 세워주며 자식의 내일을 위해 자신의 오늘을 접어두었던 그 묵묵한 헌신 위에 오늘의 대한민국이 서 있다”고 했다.)

He continued, "The earnest desire to pass on a better world to our beloved children than the present is the root of this nation and the driving force behind its prosperity and growth." President Lee emphasized the necessity of senior welfare, saying, "The birth and care of a child must blossom into pure joy, and parents who have devoted their entire lives must be able to enjoy a happy old age without worry. Only then can everyone affirm their lives tomorrow and dream of a better future." (이어 “사랑하는 내 자식들에게 지금보다 더 나은 세상을 물려주고자 했던 간절한 마음은 이 나라의 뿌리이자 번영과 성장의 원동력”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “한 아이의 탄생과 돌봄은 온전한 기쁨으로 꽃피울 수 있어야 하고, 한평생 헌신한 부모님들은 걱정 없이 행복한 노후를 누릴 수 있어야 한다. 그래야 모두가 내일의 삶을 긍정하며 더 나은 미래를 꿈꿀 수 있다”며 노인 복지의 필요성을 강조했다.)

Specifically, he introduced, "The government of the people's power is preparing institutional measures to guarantee a healthy and vibrant old age, such as 'integrated community care,' 'dementia-safe property management services,' a record-breaking '1.15 million senior jobs,' and improvement of the unfair pension system." He went on to say, "We will continue to take more meticulous and thorough care of our parents' lives and steadily expand practical support." President Lee concluded, "I hope today can be a warm time to share the gratitude and love that we may not have expressed." (구체적으로는 “국민권력정부는 ‘지역사회 통합 돌봄’, ‘치매 안심 재산 관리 서비스’, 역대 최대 규모인 ’115만개의 노인 일자리‘, 불합리한 연금 제도 개선 등 건강하고 활기찬 노후를 보장할 제도적 방안을 마련하고 있다”고 소개했다. 그러면서 “앞으로 부모님들의 삶을 더욱 세심하고 살뜰하게 보살피며, 실질적인 지원을 거듭 확대하겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “오늘 하루 미처 전하지 못했던 감사와 사랑의 마음을 함께 나누는 따뜻한 시간이 될 수 있길 바란다”고 끝맺었다.)

item.title: First Constitutional Amendment in 39 Years, Ruling Party Pushes Ahead Without Consultation (39년만의 개헌, 협의 없이 추진하는 與)
item.description:
First Constitutional Amendment in 39 Years, Ruling Party Pushes Ahead Without Consultation (39년만의 개헌, 협의 없이 추진하는 與)

The constitutional amendment bill led by the Democratic Party of Korea was brought to a plenary session of the National Assembly on the 7th, but the People Power Party's absence led to its failure. Although a bill proposed in a plenary session cannot be reintroduced in the same session if rejected, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party plan to revisit the amendment in the plenary session on the 8th, citing that the vote was invalid due to a lack of a quorum. From the early stages of the constitutional amendment push, the People Power Party has stated, "We do not oppose the content, but a hasty amendment ahead of local elections should not happen." Political circles point to this as a "predicted breakdown," as the ruling party, pushing for the first amendment in 39 years since 1987, forced the issue without agreement with the main opposition party. (더불어민주당이 주도한 헌법 개정안이 7일 국회 본회의에 상정됐지만 국민의힘이 불참해 처리가 무산됐다. 본회의에 상정된 안건이 부결되면 같은 회기에 다시 상정할 수 없지만 우원식 국회의장과 민주당은 “의결정족수 부족에 따른 투표 불성립”이라며 8일 본회의에서 개헌안을 다시 처리할 계획이다. 국민의힘은 개헌 추진 초기부터 “내용은 반대하지 않지만 지방선거를 앞둔 졸속 개헌을 해서는 안 된다”고 해왔다. 정치권에선 집권 여당이 1987년 이후 39년만에 개헌을 추진하면서 제1 야당과 합의 없이 밀어붙이다 벌어진 ‘예고된 파행’이라는 지적이 나온다.)

On this day, the National Assembly presented the amendment bill proposed on the 3rd of last month by 187 lawmakers, including those from the Democratic Party. It includes provisions to enshrine the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the constitution's preamble, and to strengthen martial law conditions, requiring immediate parliamentary approval when the president declares martial law. (국회는 이날 민주당 등 의원 187명이 지난달 3일 발의한 개헌안을 상정했다. 헌법 전문에 부마 민주 항쟁과 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 수록하고, 대통령 계엄 선포 때 즉시 국회 승인을 받도록 하는 등 계엄 요건을 강화하는 내용이 담겼다.)

However, the People Power Party, as a party line, boycotted the vote, failing to meet the quorum requirement of 191 lawmakers (more than two-thirds of the registered members). People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok said, "There was no prior agreement, and despite clearly stating our opposition as a party line, Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party forcibly brought it to the floor." (하지만 국민의힘이 당론으로 표결에 불참해 의결정족수(재적의원 3분의 2 이상)인 191명을 채우지 못했다. 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 “사전 합의도 없었을 뿐 아니라 당론으로 반대 입장을 분명히 밝혔는데도 우원식 국회의장과 민주당이 강행 상정했다”고 했다.)

After the processing failed, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Kang Yu-jeong said, "We express regret and disappointment over the vote's invalidity," adding, "People Power Party lawmakers must take responsibility as constitutional bodies and participate in voting." Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do stated, "If the People Power Party boycotts the vote, it is condoning the illegal emergency martial law." The People Power Party sees this as the opposition party pressing it with a 'judgment on insurrection' framework about 20 days before the June 3 local elections. (처리가 무산된 후 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 “투표 불성립에 안타까움과 유감을 전한다”며 “국민의힘 의원들은 헌법기관으로서 책임감을 갖고 투표에 반드시 참여해야 한다”고 했다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 “국민의힘이 표결 불참한다면 불법 비상 계엄을 두둔하는 것”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거를 20여 일 앞두고 ‘내란 심판 프레임’으로 야당 압박전에 나선 것으로 보고 있다.)

If the constitutional amendment vote fails in the plenary session on the 8th, the Democratic Party is also considering revisiting it on the 9th and 10th. The ruling party believes that to hold a national referendum on the amendment alongside the June 3 local elections, the bill must be processed by the 10th at the latest. In response to the ruling party's warning of a revote, the People Power Party plans to filibuster (unlimited debate) all bills brought to the plenary session. (민주당은 8일 본회의에서 개헌안 투표가 무산될 경우, 9일과 10일에 다시 처리하는 방안도 검토하고 있다. 여권은 6·3 지방선거 때 개헌안 국민투표를 하기 위해선 늦어도 10일까지 개헌안을 처리해야 한다고 보고 있다. 국민의힘은 여당의 재투표 예고에 본회의에 상정되는 모든 안건에 대해 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 할 계획이다.)

◇Ruling Party Cornered by 'Prosecution Withdrawal,' Continues Amendment Vote, Labeling Opposition as 'Insurrection Forces' (◇‘공소 취소’ 코너 몰린 與, 개헌 표결 계속하며 ‘野 내란세력’ 낙인)

As the Democratic Party brought the constitutional amendment bill to the National Assembly plenary session on the 8th despite the People Power Party's opposition, and the vote itself failed, political circles have suggested, "Isn't this just being pushed to pressure the opposition, knowing it wouldn't pass?" Critics argue that although the People Power Party has repeatedly expressed sympathy with amendment content like enshrining the Busan-Masan Uprising and May 18 spirit in the preamble and strengthening martial law conditions, the ruling party bypassed consultation procedures and hastily pursued the amendment's timing to align with the June 3 local elections. Constitutional scholars have opinioned, "Pushing forward with a constitutional amendment—the foundation of constitutional order—without agreement from the main opposition party could leave a historical stain." (더불어민주당이 8일 국민의힘 반대에도 개헌안을 국회 본회의에 상정해 표결 자체가 무산되자 정치권에서는 “성사가 안 될 줄 알면서도 야당 압박용으로 밀어붙인 것 아니냐”는 말이 나왔다. 부마항쟁과 5·18 정신 헌법 전문 수록, 계엄 요건 강화 등 개헌 내용에 국민의힘이 그간 재차 공감을 표했는데도 여당이 협의 절차를 건너뛰고 개헌안 처리 시점을 6·3 지방선거 일정에 맞춰 졸속 추진했다는 것이다. 헌법학계에선 “헌정 질서의 근간인 헌법 개정을 제1 야당과 합의도 없이 계속 추진하는 것은 역사적 오점으로 남을 수 있다”는 의견이 나왔다.)

When the amendment bill was brought to the plenary session, the People Power Party boycotted the vote and held a general meeting of lawmakers in the Budget and Accounts Special Committee meeting room across from the main chamber. In a statement signed by all People Power Party lawmakers, they said, "Forces that trample on the rule of law to unilaterally push a constitutional amendment to suit their tastes, using their numerical majority, is an act of betraying the people and a direct challenge to the sovereign." The People Power Party repeatedly proposed discussing a comprehensive amendment covering everything from the constitution's preamble to the power structure in the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, starting in June. (국민의힘은 국회 본회의에 개헌안이 상정되자 표결에 불참하고 본회의장 맞은편에 위치한 예산결산특별위원회 회의장에서 의원총회를 열었다. 국민의힘 의원 전원 명의의 성명에서 “법치주의를 유린하는 세력이 다수의 힘을 앞세워 자신들 입맛에 맞는 헌법 개정을 일방적으로 추진하는 것은 국민을 배신하는 행위이자, 주권자에 대한 정면 도전”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 이날 6월 시작되는 22대 국회 후반기에 헌법 전문부터 권력 구조까지 담긴 포괄적 개헌안을 논의하자고 거듭 제안했다.)

In opposition circles, there is analysis that the Democratic Party, having aggressively pushed for a 'fabricated indictment' special counsel to allow President Lee Jae-myung to withdraw charges, is now heavily promoting the constitutional amendment issue as public opinion soured ahead of the local elections. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a Supreme Council meeting at the presidential office before the plenary session, "This constitutional amendment is paving the way to ultimately push through a 'long-term dictatorship' amendment." Lawmaker Lee Jong-bae wrote on Facebook, "The Democratic Party, which pushes for a special counsel to withdraw prosecutions, has no right to mention constitutional amendments." (야권에선 민주당이 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 ‘조작기소’ 특검을 추진했다가 지방선거를 앞두고 여론이 나빠지자 개헌 이슈를 강하게 부각시키고 있다는 분석도 나온다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 본회의 전 청와대에서 최고위원 회의에서 “이번 개헌으로 길을 닦고, ‘장기 독재’ 개헌으로 끝까지 가보겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 이종배 의원은 페이스북에 “공소취소 특검법 추진하는 민주당은 헌법 개정을 언급할 자격이 없다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party fiercely criticized the opposition for boycotting the vote. Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do said, "The People Power Party, far from sincerely apologizing for the insurrection and far-right incitement, is only obsessed with nominating 'Yoon-adain' candidates," warning, "If they evade their historical and era-bound responsibility for the constitutional amendment, they will face the judgment of the people." Lawmaker Kim Hyun-jung stated, "The Democratic Party will use a roll-call vote to etch the People Power Party's atrocities in history." Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, also issued a statement on Facebook, saying, "I want to ask if the People Power Party is still defying the command of the era and living in a delusion with Yoon Seok-yeol, the ringleader of the insurrection," adding, "This local election is an election to end the insurrection." (민주당은 표결에 불참한 야당을 맹비난했다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 “국민의힘은 내란과 극우 선동에 대한 진정한 사죄는커녕 윤어게인 공천에만 혈안이 돼 있다”며 “개헌이라는 역사와 시대의 책임을 회피한다면 국민의 심판에 직면하게 될 것”이라고 했다. 김현정 의원은 “민주당은 기명 투표로 국민의힘 만행을 역사에 박제하겠다”고 했다. 추미애 민주당 경기도지사 후보도 이날 페이스북에 입장을 내고 “국민의힘은 여전히 시대의 명령을 거슬러 윤석열 내란수괴와 함께 망상 속에 있는 것은 아닌지 묻고 싶다”며 “이번 지방선거는 내란을 종식시켜야 하는 선거”라고 했다.)

Among experts, there are criticisms that the opportunity for a constitutional amendment, coming after 39 years, has degenerated into a political tool ahead of the elections. Professor Emeritus Jang Young-soo of Korea University's Law School said, "The requirement for approval by more than two-thirds of the National Assembly's registered members means the highest law, the constitution, must be changed through consensus between the ruling and opposition parties, but this was completely disregarded." He added, "In this amendment, this spirit of consensus was undermined from the proposal stage, and even minimal procedures for gathering public opinion were skipped. It's also a problem that, despite being the first amendment in 39 years, core content like restructuring power was not included." A former constitutional research official said, "It was also inappropriate for the ruling party to launch political attacks slandering the opposition during the amendment discussion process." (전문가들 사이에서는 39년 만에 찾아온 개헌의 기회가 선거를 앞두고 정략 도구로 전락했다는 지적이 나왔다. 장영수 고려대 법학전문대학원 명예교수는 “국회 재적의원 3분의 2 이상의 찬성이 필요하다는 것은, 여야 합의로 최고법인 헌법을 바꿔야 한다는 의미인데 이번에 그것이 전혀 지켜지지 않았다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “이번 개헌안에선 이 같은 합의 정신이 발의 단계에서부터 훼손됐고, 국민 의견을 수렴하는 최소한의 절차조차 거치지 않았다”며 “39년 만의 헌법 개정인데 권력 구조 개편과 같은 핵심적인 내용이 반영되지 않은 점도 문제”라고 했다. 전직 헌법연구관은 “개헌 논의 과정에서 여권이 야당을 비방하는 정치 공세를 편 것도 부적절했다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 6th, the day before the plenary session, President Lee Jae-myung said at a cabinet meeting, "Shouldn't we consider those opposing (the constitutional amendment) as advocates of illegal martial law?" National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik also stated at a press conference on the 27th of last month, "Some ask if the forces that hate the amendment the most are not the 'Yoon-adain' group, and there are also criticisms that the People Power Party leadership is tied to 'Yoon-adain.'" (앞서 이재명 대통령이 본회의 하루 전인 지난 6일 국무회의에서 “(개헌에) 반대하는 사람은 불법 계엄 옹호론자라고 봐야 하지 않겠느냐”고 말했다. 우원식 국회의장도 지난달 27일 기자회견에서 “혹자는 개헌을 가장 싫어하는 세력이 ‘윤어게인’ 아니냐고 반문하고, 국민의힘 지도부가 윤어게인에 묶여 있다는 지적도 있다”고 밝혔다.)

A political source noted, "In 2018, a constitutional amendment proposed by President Moon Jae-in was pushed through by the then-ruling party, resulting in a failed plenary vote and leaving a stain on constitutional amendment history," adding, "It doesn't add up for the ruling party to force through various bills using its majority while demanding the opposition join the amendment initiative." A People Power Party source remarked, "If President Lee is sincere about the constitutional amendment, he should take responsibility, propose the bill, and work to persuade the People Power Party, but isn't that completely absent?" (정치권 관계자는 “2018년에도 문재인 대통령이 발의한 개헌안이 당시 여당 주도로 강행 추진돼 본회의 표결 불성립이 되며 개헌 역사에 오점이 남았다”면서 “여당이 의석수를 앞세워 각종 법안을 강행 처리하면서 야당에 개헌에 동참하라고 요구하는 건 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다”고 했다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “이 대통령이 개헌에 진심이라면, 본인이 책임지고 개헌안을 제안하고 국민의힘을 설득하는 노력을 해야 하는데, 그런 모습이 전혀 없지 않으냐”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to hold a plenary session on the 8th to put the constitutional amendment to a vote. If it is not processed by the plenary session on the 10th, a national referendum on the amendment during these local elections will effectively be difficult to conduct. (민주당은 8일 본회의를 열어 개헌안을 표결에 부칠 예정이다. 오는 10일 본회의 때까지 표결 처리가 되지 않으면 이번 지방선거에서 개헌안의 찬반을 묻는 국민투표는 사실상 실시되기 어려울 전망이다.)

☞Invalid Vote (☞투표 불성립)

This refers to a case where a plenary session vote fails to proceed because the quorum is not met. No vote count takes place. Unlike a rejection, it is interpreted that the principle of "one matter, one decision" does not apply. (국회 본회의 표결에서 의결 정족수가 미달돼 투표 자체가 성립하지 않은 경우를 뜻한다. 개표도 이뤄지지 않는다. 부결과 달리 일사부재의(一事不再議) 원칙이 적용되지 않는다는 해석이 나온다.)

item.title: DP Rep. Lee So-young on Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel: "Simply Proposed by Some Lawmakers" (與 이소영, 조작기소 특검 두고 “그냥 일부 의원들이 발의한 것”)
item.description:
Rep. Lee So-young of the Democratic Party of Korea (DP) stated on the 8th regarding the party-proposed special counsel bill for manipulated indictments, "From the ground up, after the local elections, there should be intense discussions, and the content, timing, and methods need to be newly decided." (이소영 더불어민주당 의원은 8일 민주당이 발의한 조작기소 특검에 대해 “원점에서 지방선거 이후 격렬한 토론을 거쳐 내용이든, 시기든, 방식 이런 것들이 새롭게 결정돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Appearing on YTN's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Room" that morning, the lawmaker said, "I believe there is a need to push for a special counsel, but on the specific details, internal deliberation among lawmakers is required, and that process has not taken place." (이 의원은 이날 오전 YTN 장성철의 뉴스명당에 출연해 “특검 추진 필요성은 있다고 생각하지만 구체적인 내용에 대해서는 의원들 내부에서 숙의 절차가 필요한데 그런 것들은 진행되지 않았다”고 했다.)

She added, "There has never been a single discussion on this matter at a policy caucus or general party meeting; it was simply proposed by some lawmakers." (또 “이 내용과 관련해 정책 의총이나 의총 토론 한 번 거친 적이 없고 그냥 일부 의원들이 발의를 한 것”이라고 했다.)

"For a bill with this level of importance and scope, to push it forward, multiple general meetings to hear the opinions of all lawmakers would normally be held," Lee said. "I don't think it's true that this was intended to be processed before the local elections." (이 의원은 “이 정도의 중요성이나 내용을 가지고 있는 법안을 추진하려면 전체적인 의원의 의견을 듣는 의총이 여러 번 열린다거나 그렇게 진행되는 것”이라며 “마치 이걸 지선 전에 처리하려고 했다고 하는 것은 사실이라고 생각하지 않는다”고 했다.)

Regarding holding a general meeting, the lawmaker noted, "On the issue of granting the authority to revoke indictments, there are indeed various controversies, including from a legal theory perspective. I will reflect deeply on those aspects and speak with conviction." (이 의원은 의원총회를 진행할 경우 “공소 취소 권한을 부여하는 문제에 대해서는 법학 이론적으로도 그렇고 여러 가지 논란이 있을 수 있는 것은 사실”이라며 “그런 부분에 대해서 숙고하고 소신 있게 발언할 것”이라고 했다.)

She continued, "If there were those who initially wanted to push this before the local elections, I would have raised objections and put the brakes on it. This is an issue that requires sufficient gathering of public opinion and inevitably involves intense debate among lawmakers. I don't think everyone agrees on it." The DP's leadership decided to postpone discussions on the special counsel until after the local elections. (그러면서 “애초에 지방선거 이전에 추진하자고 하는 분들이 있었으면 반대 의견을 내고 제동을 걸었을 것”이라며 “이런 문제는 국민 의견도 충분히 수렴해야 하고 의원들 안에서도 격렬한 논쟁이 있을 수밖에 없는 사안이다. 모두가 다 동의한다고 생각하지 않는다”고 했다. 민주당 원내지도부는 특검 논의를 지방선거 이후로 미루기로 했다.)

On the KOSPI surpassing the 7,000-point mark, she said, "I believe the policy focus should now shift away from leading stocks to how to ensure that companies that are still undervalued are properly assessed and normalized. I proposed a law to prevent stock price suppression a year ago, and it's currently being processed with the goal of passing this year." (코스피가 7000선을 돌파한 것에 대해서는 “이제는 주도주 중심보다는 아직도 저평가돼 있는 기업들을 어떻게 다시 제대로 평가받게 할 거냐, 정상화할 거냐는 거에 대해서 정책의 중심이 옮겨가야 한다고 생각한다”며 “주가 누르기 방지법을 1년 전에 이미 발의했는데 올해 통과를 목표로 진행 중”이라고 했다.)

"The government is also preparing its own bill based on my proposal," Lee said. "The government's tax revision bill is expected to be released in July. There is my bill and the government's bill, so they will likely undergo comprehensive review." (이 의원은 “정부도 제 법안을 참고한 정부안을 준비하고 있는 상황”이라며 “올해 7월에 정부 세법 개정안이 나올 것 같다. 제 법안과 정부안이 있는데 아마 (종합 심사)할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Constitutional Amendment Pushed Through Without Consultation with Opposition... Ultimately, Woo Won-shik Says "Will Not Proceed" (野와 협의없이 밀어붙인 개헌... 결국 우원식 “상정 안하겠다”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik announced on the 8th during a plenary session that, in response to the People Power Party's request for a filibuster (unlimited debate) regarding the constitutional amendment, "I will not put the Republic of Korea's constitutional amendment bill forward for consideration." (우원식 국회의장이 8일 국회 본회의에서 헌법개정안과 관련한 국민의힘의 필리버스터(무제한토론) 신청에 “대한민국 헌법개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Initially, the Democratic Party planned to push the constitutional amendment by holding plenary sessions on the 9th and 10th to pressure the opposition, believing it had to be processed by at least the 10th to hold a national referendum on the amendment during the local elections. However, after the People Power Party signaled a filibuster on all items submitted to the plenary session, the decision was made not to proceed with the submission. (당초 민주당은 지방선거 때 개헌안 국민투표를 하기 위해선 늦어도 10일까지 개헌안을 처리해야 한다고 보고 9일과 10일에도 본회의를 열어 야당을 압박하겠다는 계획이었다. 그러나 국민의힘은 본회의에 상정되는 모든 안건에 대한 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 예고하자 본회의 상정을 하지 않기로 한 것이다.)

Speaker Woo stated, "Regarding the constitutional amendment—the first in 39 years, one that would prevent even the dream of a martial law decree—the People Power Party yesterday rendered it void by not participating in the vote, and today they declared they would engage in unlimited debate. As the Speaker, I am halting all procedures. I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party." (우 의장은 “39년 만에 하는 헌법 개정안, 비상계엄을 꿈도 못 꾸게 하는 개헌안에 대해 국민의힘은 어제는 투표에 참여하지 않아 무산시키고, 오늘은 무제한 토론을 하겠다고 하니 의장으로서 모든 절차를 중단한다”며 “국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표하지 않을 수 없다”고 말했다.)

Speaker Woo also adjourned the meeting without submitting around 50 non-contentious livelihood-related bills that were originally scheduled for handling during the plenary session. (우 의장은 국회 본회의에서 처리 예정이던 비쟁점 민생 관련 법안 50여건도 상정하지 않고 회의를 산회했다.)

The Democratic Party blamed the collapse of the constitutional amendment on the People Power Party's opposition and plans to escalate pressure on the opposition party with about 20 days remaining until the June 3 local elections. (민주당은 “개헌 무산은 국민의힘의 반대 탓”이라며 6·3 지방선거를 20여일 앞두고 야당에 대한 압박 수위를 높이겠다는 계획이다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party countered, "Pushing it through hastily without any consultation with the opposition essentially admits it was nothing but an 'election stunt constitutional amendment show.'" They also see the ruling camp's use of a "martial law judgment" frame to pressure the opposition, and plan to intensify public opposition against the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictment," which could allow the dismissal of the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung's case. (반면 국민의힘은 “야당과 아무런 협의없이 졸속으로 밀어붙인건 결국 ‘선거용 개헌쇼’라는 걸 자인한 셈”이라고 했다 또 여권이 ‘내란 심판 프레임’을 통해 야당 압박에 나선 것으로 보고, 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있도록 한 ‘조작 기소’특검 법안에 대한 반대 여론전에도 힘을 쏟겠다는 방침이다.)

item.title: Main Opposition Party Nominates Kim Young-bin for By-election in Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang, Chungnam… Wrapping Up Nominations for 14 Districts (與, 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐에 김영빈 공천…14곳 공천 마무리)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 8th that it would strategically nominate attorney Kim Young-bin for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, Chungcheongnam-do, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections. This completes the party's nominations for by-elections in 14 constituencies. (더불어민주당은 6·3 지방선거와 같이 치러지는 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거에 김영빈 변호사를 전략 공천한다고 8일 밝혔다. 이로써 민주당의 14개 지역구 재보선 공천은 마무리됐다.)

Attorney Kim, a native of Gongju, Chungnam, graduated from Korea University's law school and is a member of the 37th class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute. He began his career as a prosecutor at the Incheon District Prosecutors' Office and later worked at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office and the Office of the Minister of Justice's Policy Advisor, among other positions. (김 변호사는 충남 공주 출신으로 고려대 법대를 졸업했으며 사법연수원 37기다. 인천지검에서 검사 생활을 시작해 서울중앙지검과 법무부 장관 정책보좌관실 등에서 일했다.)

On this day, party leader Jeong Cheong-rae introduced Attorney Kim at a recruitment event for electoral talents, stating, "He is a person of Gongju and Chungcheong-do through and through," adding, "I am truly delighted that he has stepped forward to apply the administrative experience and capabilities he gained at the prosecution and the Ministry of Justice to the development of Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang." (정청래 대표는 이날 선거 인재 영입식에서 김 변호사를 소개하며 “뼛속까지 공주 사람이자 충청도 사람”이라며 “검찰과 법무부에서 쌓은 행정 경험과 역량을 이제는 공주·부여·청양의 발전을 위해 쓰겠다고 나서줘서 정말 기쁘다”고 했다.)

Attorney Kim said, "I will repay the grace of my hometown and the trust of the Democratic Party, which has embraced me, with my whole being," and added, "I will now begin the great first step toward the greater leap of Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, with the prepared Kim Young-bin's fresh perspective in his 40s." (김 변호사는 “고향의 은혜와 저를 안아준 민주당의 믿음에 온몸을 맞춰 보답하겠다”며 “준비된 김영빈이 새로운 40대의 시선으로 공주·부여·청양의 더 큰 도약을 향한 위대한 첫걸음을 지금 시작하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Tears at Parents' Day Address: "Wishing Health and Peace to All Parents in This Land" (李대통령, 눈물의 어버이날 축사 “이 땅의 모든 부모님들께 건강과 평안이 함께 하길”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung shed tears at the 54th Parents' Day ceremony on the 8th, pledging that the state would fulfill the duties and responsibilities of filial piety toward the parents of fallen public officials. <<> During the ceremony held that morning at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, President Lee attended the 54th Parents' Day event, pinned carnations on behalf of their children for the parents of fallen public officials, and delivered a speech. President Lee said, "As I handed out the carnations, I found myself tearing up too," adding, "Your hearts must be aching. I offer my condolences." First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, who was also present, showed tears as well. This marks the first time a presidential couple has attended the Parents' Day ceremony together. <<> In the latter part of the speech, when President Lee mentioned, "There are those who are suffering, longing for family they can no longer meet," his voice choked and trembled, and he struggled to continue. President Lee continued in a faltering voice, "Here today with us are the parents of fallen public officials who left our side while protecting the lives of the people." <<> President Lee stated, "I know well that before the sorrow of having to send a beloved child away first, no words can fully offer comfort," and said, "I will solemnly remember the noble sacrifice of those young people who fulfilled their duties to the very end in the most dangerous sites." He added, "With the resolve that the state will fulfill its filial duties and responsibilities and stay by your side until the end, I have pinned carnations for the bereaved families today," and "I pray for health and peace to be with all parents in this land." <<> President Lee also remarked, "A parent carries the world as many times as the number of children they have," adding, "It's something I only truly realized after becoming a father of two." He emphasized, "I extend deep respect and gratitude to all parents in this land who are dedicated to their families and the nation," and "Rather than a society reliant on the unilateral sacrifice of parents, I will move toward a 'country where all citizens are happy,' where the state and community share responsibility." <<> President Lee said, "Fathers and mothers who have devoted their entire lives must be able to enjoy a worry-free and happy old age," adding, "Only in a country where raising children is not a burden to parents and supporting parents is not a burden to children can everyone affirm tomorrow's life and dream of a better future." <<> President Lee announced, "The people's sovereignty government is diligently preparing institutional measures to ensure a healthy and vibrant old age, such as 'integrated community care,' 'dementia-safe property management services,' a record high of '1.15 million senior jobs,' and improvements to unreasonable pension systems," and stated, "Going forward, we will care for the lives of parents more attentively and meticulously, and continuously expand practical systems and support." <<> About 230 people were invited to the ceremony, including exemplary filial piety awardees, parents of fallen fire and police officials, and elderly individuals living alone. Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, Senior Presidential Secretary for Social Affairs Moon Jin-young, Minister of Health and Welfare Jeong Eun-kyung, and President of the Korean Senior Citizens Association Lee Jung-geun attended. Parents of police and fire officials who died while responding to incidents such as fires in Mungyeong, North Gyeongsang Province, and Gimje, North Jeolla Province, were present. <<> Regarding the attendance of only Democratic Party of Korea leader Jeong Cheong-rae among party leaders at the ceremony, President Lee asked Minister Jeong Eun-kyung, "You invited all party leaders, right? Surely you didn't only invite Representative Jeong Cheong-rae," and then explained, "Because it's a sensitive time, I was worried there might be strange misunderstandings, so I said the others couldn't come due to busy schedules." (이재명 대통령이 8일 제54회 어버이날 기념식에서 순직 공무원 부모님들께 국가가 자식의 도리와 책임을 다하겠다고 밝히며 눈물을 흘렸다.)
